sample: 12 amb/12 dis, 6 each interior R unknown [.05,.95] and saturated; category round-robin seeded random, all 24 distinct templates; exclude all previous intervention templates. Stratification uses preexisting R only, not new intervention responses; enriched sample, not population representative or fresh observational holdout.
calibration: Median norm of existing UN0-CN0 and UN1-CN1 hidden-state differences projected onto Fear/Anxiety/Desperation span. Exclude old and new pilot templates. One common absolute L2 dose, fixed before outcome analysis; no dose adjustment.
primary: 48 tests: 2 ambiguity types x 2 threat levels x 3 axes x 2 modes (CN+ sufficiency; UN- attenuation) x 2 outcomes (unknown, equal-case person bias). Holm across48. Exact two-sided paired sign-flip (4096) assuming sign symmetry; 2000 paired template bootstrap CI, unadjusted.
specificity: Same48 contrasts versus matched-sign orthogonal random direction, Holm separate48; require same contrast significant vs sham and random for specificity. Direct Anxiety-Fear and Desperation-Fear contrasts secondary, Holm separate32.
natural_effect_check: Matched UN0-CN0 and UN1-CN1 in sham must be reported with CI. Directional reproduction/attenuation requires agreement with original behavioral effect; if natural effect CI includes0 do not claim reproduced mediation.
person_bias: Main equal mean of per-rotation p_biased/(p_biased+p_anti); pooled probability-mass weighted conditional ratio also reported, including prespecified paired-swap tests (24), separate Holm. No outcome-based switching of estimand.
quality: Nine-arm smoke before main; baseline reproduction<1e-6, actual hook displacement<1e-5, finite outputs, full-vocabulary numeric choice mass, all11 axis shifts, argmax transitions. No graphs emitted in smoke.
interpretation: Single dose/layer exploratory computational intervention, no subjective emotion or natural indirect-effect identification. UN/CN prompts remain confounded with length, wording, time and control cues. Reused axes are not validated emotion intensity scales.
stop_rule: Pause on sustained critical memory pressure/active swap deterioration or insufficient disk; abort on smoke or finite-value failure; no dose increase after observing results.
